devdoc.details: The contract is agnostic to what an id represents (Pool, Lender, or Pool Manager) and to the meaning of each generic Metadata field - the caller-supplied name tags define that meaning per id.

params._newOwner: The address of the new admin.
params._oldOwner: The address of the previous admin.

params._metadata: The metadata stored against the id.

params._index: The Metadata struct field index the caption applies to.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params._newOwner: The address of the new admin.

params._index: The Metadata struct field index (0-9) the caption applies to.
params._name: The caption to assign, e.g. "Reserve Wallet".

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

devdoc.title: CsigmaMetadata

AdminTransferred(address,address).notice: Emitted when the admin role is transferred.

MetadataUpdated(string,(address,uint32,u.notice: Emitted when metadata is created or updated for an id.

NameTagUpdated(string,uint8,string,strin.notice: Emitted when the name tag (caption) of a metadata field is created or updated.

ROLE_MANAGER().notice: Role identifier for accounts allowed to create/update metadata and name tags.

getMetadata(string).notice: Returns all metadata associated with the given entity id.

getNameTag(string,uint8).notice: Returns the display name (caption) of a specific metadata field for an entity id.

grantRole(bytes32,address).notice: Grants a role to an account

initialize(address,address).notice: Initializes the contract with the given admin and manager addresses.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).notice: Revokes a role from an account

transferAdmin(address).notice: Transfers DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to a new address.

updateMetadata(string,(address,uint32,ui.notice: Creates or updates metadata for a given entity (Pool, Lender, or Pool Manager id).

updateNameTag(string,uint8,string).notice: Creates or updates the display name (caption) of a metadata field for an entity.

userdoc.notice: Stores configurable, protocol-owned metadata and human-readable name tags against a Pool, Lender, or Pool Manager id, so white-labeled pool managers can carry attributes that are not common across the wider cSigma pdn.
